statements.statement: Paper C describes CARLA as an open-source urban driving simulator.
CARLA supports development, training, and validation of autonomous driving systems.
CARLA supports flexible specification of sensor suites and environmental conditions.
CARLA provides free urban environment content such as urban layouts, vehicles, buildings, and pedestrians.
CARLA supports training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models including perception and control.
CARLA provides measurements of agent state and traffic rule compliance.
